Island discount tax basis and exact taxable base/rounding unknown; full-tariff 3% provision conservative. Hakuunso advertised tax added once. Conflicting or overlapping cancellation boundaries retained.

FX and food/accessory/local-transport/insurance amounts are assumptions. Refundable deposits and FX/card fees may require extra cash. No shopping, alcohol, childcare or off-piste activity funded.
